blocks.x: In Healthcare & Life Sciences, the working pattern is ambient clinical documentation: visit audio to structured draft notes in EHR templates with clinician sign-off. Documentation time down 25%+ is the measured outcome the gate checks. Everything upstream of it, data, identity, access, is built to keep that pattern honest.

blocks.x: Nothing scales before the baseline is signed. imaging and diagnostic backlogs is measured with your finance and risk leads in the room, then one working path, ambient clinical documentation, goes live inside the quarter. Baselines are signed in the first two weeks, the working slice lands inside the quarter, and the value ledger stays open to your finance team. For Healthcare & Life Sciences, that discipline is not optional, it is the engagement model.

For the Applied AI & GenAI side of Healthcare & Life Sciences, the binding duties are concrete, HIPAA / HITECH (PHI safeguards, BAAs, breach notification and audit trails); GDPR / EU health-data regimes (special-category data, DPIAs and cross-border transfer controls); FDA SaMD / CDS guidance (clinical decision support under enforcement discretion boundaries and validation duties). We design against them from the first sprint so the audit reads the system, not a binder.
